_readme: Source of truth for the mashup. Change a sheet before changing code. null = unfilled/unverified cell; the preflight must list every null and every unresolved reference before a build. Never copy game files: reference them where they are via the folder tokens.

games.launch: null (decide whether it must run at all; fights are shown as results)

fights.resolution: simulated result from both fighters' ratings

hooks_into_host.purpose: scouting, gym, training and fight-offer screens inside the host
read the real Undisputed roster from the player's own install
advance training, contracts and fight offers each in-game week
keep gym, fighters and results between sessions

listing.title: Fight Camp Manager
listing.tagline: Run a boxing gym inside Football Manager 26, with Undisputed's real fighters.
listing.description: Start with an empty gym and a small budget, scout boxers from your own Undisputed install, sign one, train weekly and take fight offers. Solo career. Needs both games installed; nothing from either game is copied.
